design_bible: A sheer grey granite sea cliff seen from the opposite side of a narrow cove, the open sea and the horizon behind, blue sky with scattered white clouds

hook_title.fr: Ils ont construit un refuge dans le vide
hook_title.en: They built a cabin over the void

loop_note: La cabane allumée au crépuscule répond à la falaise nue du premier plan, même cadre.

scenes.visual_prompt: The untouched bare granite cliff above the sea
scenes.edit_prompt: Remove the ropes, the bolts, the drilled holes and the workers: the untouched bare granite cliff.
scenes.motion_prompt: rope-access workers abseil down the cliff and drill anchor holes into the rock

scenes.visual_prompt: Rope-access workers drilling anchor holes into the cliff
scenes.edit_prompt: Remove the steel beams: the bare rock with a few freshly drilled holes and steel bolts; two climbing ropes hang from the top of the cliff and two small rope-access workers in orange harnesses and white helmets hang on them, drilling the rock.
scenes.motion_prompt: two black steel beams are lifted and bolted into the rock

scenes.visual_prompt: Two black steel cantilever beams anchored into the rock
scenes.edit_prompt: Remove the steel floor platform and the safety railing: only the two black steel cantilever beams anchored into the rock remain, sticking out over the void, one worker in a harness on a rope beside them.
scenes.motion_prompt: a steel floor platform is laid on the beams, a yellow safety railing and a scaffolding tower go up

scenes.visual_prompt: A steel floor platform on the beams with a yellow safety railing
scenes.edit_prompt: Remove all the timber: only a flat steel floor platform on the two black steel beams remains, with a temporary yellow safety railing and two workers bolting it.
scenes.motion_prompt: wooden wall studs rise quickly on the platform

scenes.visual_prompt: The lower timber wall frame on the platform
scenes.edit_prompt: Remove the roof rafters and the upper half of the walls: only the timber floor and the lower part of the wooden wall studs remain, with stacks of timber beams on the floor and two workers.
scenes.motion_prompt: roof rafters are assembled on top of the timber frame

scenes.visual_prompt: The bare timber frame with roof rafters
scenes.edit_prompt: Remove the black metal roof covering and the wall membrane: only the bare timber frame remains, vertical wooden studs and roof rafters, with daylight passing through; keep the scaffolding; two workers on the frame.
scenes.motion_prompt: the roof is covered with black metal sheets and the walls are wrapped in grey membrane

scenes.visual_prompt: Black roof and grey membrane walls
scenes.edit_prompt: Remove the timber cladding of the walls, the walls are covered with a light grey waterproof membrane; the window openings stay empty. Keep the black roof, the scaffolding and the workers.
scenes.motion_prompt: timber cladding boards are nailed onto the walls

scenes.visual_prompt: Timber cladding, empty window openings, scaffolding
scenes.edit_prompt: Remove the large glass front, the window openings are empty and dark with bare timber posts; remove the deck boards, only the steel frame of the deck remains. Keep the scaffolding and the workers.
scenes.motion_prompt: large glass panels are installed in the window openings

scenes.visual_prompt: Glass installed, deck without railing, scaffolding tower
scenes.edit_prompt: Remove the glass railing and the furniture of the deck; add a small aluminium scaffolding tower beside the deck, stacks of wooden planks on the deck and two construction workers in orange high-visibility vests and white helmets working on the deck.
scenes.motion_prompt: the scaffolding is taken down, the deck gets its glass railing and furniture

scenes.visual_prompt: A small modern mountain refuge built on a sheer grey granite sea cliff: a compact timber cabin with a black metal roof, a large glass front and a wooden deck with a glass railing, resting on two black steel cantilever beams anchored into the rock. A narrow steel staircase with a handrail climbs along the rock from a lower ledge to the entrance door. The cabin is in the center of the frame and fully visible, with bare rock above and below it; the deep blue sea and the horizon behind; bright afternoon sun
scenes.motion_prompt: the sun sets and the lights turn on

scenes.visual_prompt: The same refuge at dusk, warm lights on
scenes.edit_prompt: Change the time of day to dusk: deep blue evening sky with a warm orange glow on the horizon, warm lights glow inside the cabin and under the deck, the sea is dark blue with reflections. Keep the building, the cliff and the framing exactly the same.
scenes.motion_prompt: slow push-in toward the glowing cabin on the cliff, calm evening sea

fr.title: Un refuge suspendu au-dessus de la mer 🌊
fr.description: 72 jours de chantier en accéléré : une cabane de bois accrochée à une falaise de granit, de la roche nue au refuge allumé au crépuscule.

en.title: A cabin hanging over the sea 🌊
en.description: 72 days of construction in time-lapse: a timber cabin anchored to a granite cliff, from bare rock to a glowing refuge at dusk.
